lesson-intro.text: Somebody is getting a present. It's a cube wearing a lid, a ribbon and a bow. There are lots of lines, all easy ones. Watch the wrapping, then wrap yours.

bow.text: We start with the bow. Draw a small circle for the knot. Add a fat loop on each side.

lid-top.text: Behind the bow is the lid's top, a flat diamond. Draw its edges around the bow.

lid-sides.text: Give the lid some depth. Draw three short lines down, one at each corner.

lid-bottom.text: Now join them along the bottom. The ribbon leaves a gap on each side.

box.text: The box sits under the lid. Draw three long uprights, then two edges along the bottom.

ribbon-top.text: Now the ribbon. From the bow, two lines run to each front edge. One goes to each back edge.

ribbon-left.text: Carry the ribbon down the left side with two straight lines.

ribbon-right.text: Do the same down the right side. The ribbon goes all the way around.

color-sides.text: Color the left sides blue and the right sides purple.

color-ribbon-top.text: The ribbon is cream where it crosses the top.

color-bands.text: The bands are yellow on the left, orange on the right. The bow is yellow, its knot orange.

lesson-outro.text: All wrapped up, with a bow on top. Who is your present for?
